summary.headline: Lords of Life and Death
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging death, health, and infirmity through the lords of the houses of life and death, their dispositions, conjunctions, oppositions, and receptions. The lord of life and Moon are compared with planets signifying health, while the lord of death and other malefic planets are assessed for impediments.
